scope: Two candidates for each of the three gadget prompts; six original PNGs
status: Candidates for batch review; production cleanup and installation are on the project owner side
grid_note: 32x32 was requested for all gadgets. The requested_grid field is the brief, not a verified measurement of generated cells.

assets.prompt:
Pixel-art sticker icon for a cozy puzzle game, drawn on a strict 32x32 pixel grid and shown large with crisp hard-edged pixels (no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smoothing). Flat colors only: no gradients, no glossy highlights, no 3D, no photo. Palette: dark graphite #23262f for outlines and details, off-white paper #f6f3ec for light areas, and one accent color, orange #f07c00. A thick off-white #f6f3ec die-cut sticker border around the whole silhouette, risograph zine style. Plain flat #f6f3ec background (transparent if supported). One object, centered, filling about 80% of a square frame. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, frame, or drop shadow.

Subject: a classic round cartoon bomb, solid graphite with a single small paper-colored highlight, a short fuse on top with a little orange flame and two sparks. Simple and chunky. Reads at a glance, even tiny, as: a bomb.

Production requirement: this is a DIGITAL low-resolution bitmap game icon, not a physical sticker or illustration with a pixel filter. Draw a genuine coarse 32x32 logical pixel grid enlarged uniformly, hard square steps of one consistent size. Aim for one dominant silhouette and ONE identifying detail, legible at 18px; leave out decorative marks and fine interior lines. Sticker border is a solid paper #f6f3ec band that follows the object's pixel silhouette closely, not a circular/colored backing disc. One subject only, no scene, no extra props or symbols. Use only the exact listed flat solid colors; no grey shading, gradients, metallic sheen, material lighting, paper grain, speckles, smudges, blur or drop shadow. Keep the full object AND border comfortably within the central 80% of the square frame, with clear fully transparent margins on all four sides. Transparent PNG, 1024x1024 or larger. No trimming, resizing or production cleanup is requested.
Candidate 1 of 2. Use the subject description exactly, with the simplest recognizable shape.
assets.review_note: Round graphite bomb, paper highlight, short fuse and orange flame with two sparks.

corrections.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct this gadget-sponge candidate to match the brief's SINGLE SMALL SPOT OF INK.
